title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan to Visit Andhra Pradesh on October 26–27
subtitle: Vice-President to Attend Ruby Jubilee Celebrations of Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences in Vijayawada
body_text: The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Andhra Pradesh on October 26–27, 2026. On October 26, the Vice-President will be the Chief Guest at the 40th (Ruby Jubilee) Anniversary Celebrations of Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences in Vijayawada. During the visit, he will offer prayers at Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple in Tirupati and Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple in Tiruchanur *** PR/ASM/VMJ
